AiImport.description: Upload a data entry file and discuss it with the assistant, which checks what the instance already holds.
AiImport.title: Import assistant

upload.title: Upload your data entry file
upload.hint: An .xlsx, .xlsm or .xls workbook. Only the headers, a sample of rows and the text of instruction sheets are sent to the language model — never the whole file.
upload.analysing: Reading the file and checking the instance…
upload.noWrite: This page writes nothing to the databases. It produces a report.

chat.title: Conversation
chat.placeholder: Ask a question about this file…
chat.consulting: The assistant is querying the instance…
chat.assistantUnreachable: The assistant could not be reached. The file analysis beside this conversation is still valid: it was produced without the assistant, and the instance was checked without it too.
chat.tooManyLookups: The assistant kept looking things up without reaching a conclusion. Try asking a narrower question, or look at the analysis beside this conversation.

report.title: What the instance already holds
report.complete: Everything is in place: nothing to create before importing.

hint.experimentMissing: No experiment carries this name. Create it, or tell the assistant which existing experiment the trial corresponds to.
hint.experimentAmbiguous: Several experiments carry this name, so the right one cannot be chosen automatically.
hint.projectMissing: No project carries this name. Ask the user which project the trial belongs to, or create it.
hint.variableInSharedResource: This variable exists on a shared resource instance. It can be imported from here, with its entity, characteristic, method and unit, in one step.
hint.variableMissing: No variable matches this column. Ask the user what it measures, with which method and in which unit.
hint.variableMissingWithExternalId: No variable matches this column. The file gives the ontology identifier {externalId}, which can be used to create it.
hint.germplasmMissing: No germplasm carries this name. Check the naming convention with the user before creating anything.
hint.facilityMissing: No facility carries this name. Create it from the facilities screen, or tell the assistant which existing one the field corresponds to.
hint.objectsNeedAnExperiment: Scientific objects live inside an experiment, and no experiment could be resolved yet. Settle the experiment first, then revalidate.
hint.objectMissing: No scientific object carries this name in the experiment.
hint.ambiguous: Several resources carry this name, so a human has to pick one.
hint.personMissing: Nobody here matches this person. Create them, or say which existing person they are.

report.empty: Nothing to check in this category.
report.createTitle: Create from this row, with the name filled in
report.createVariableTitle: Open the variable form, name and identifier prefilled. Entity, characteristic, method and unit are chosen from what the instance has, or created from that form.

warning.projectLookupFailed: The project '{name}' could not be looked up.
warning.variableLookupFailed: The variable '{name}' could not be looked up locally.
warning.externalIdLookupFailed: Variables could not be looked up by the ontology identifier {externalId}.
warning.datatypeUnreadable: The expected data type of some variables could not be read, so type mismatches were not checked for them.
warning.germplasmLookupFailed: The germplasm '{name}' could not be looked up.
warning.facilitiesLookupFailed: The facilities could not be looked up.
warning.facilityLookupFailed: The facility '{name}' could not be looked up.
warning.objectsLookupFailed: The scientific objects could not be looked up.
warning.personLookupFailed: The person '{name}' could not be looked up.

suggestion.noDeclaredDatatype: The matching variable declares no data type, so the values cannot be checked. Consider setting one on the variable.
suggestion.mixedValues: This column mixes several kinds of value, which no single data type accepts. Split it, or record the odd values in a comment column.
suggestion.emptyColumn: This column is empty, so nothing can be deduced about it.
suggestion.mixedBeforeCreating: This column mixes several kinds of value; decide what it measures before creating a variable for it.
suggestion.createWithDatatype: No variable matches this column. Its values look like {kind}, so create it with the data type {datatype}.
suggestion.wholeVersusDecimal: The variable expects whole numbers but this column holds decimals. Either change the variable's data type to decimal, or round the values.
suggestion.numberVersusText: The variable expects numbers but this column holds text. Check whether it is the right variable, or whether the values are coded.
suggestion.dateExpected: The variable expects dates but this column does not hold any.
suggestion.kindMismatch: The variable expects {expected} but this column holds {observed}.

problem.boolean: not a true or false value

fix.roundOrChangeDatatype: Round it, or change the variable's data type to decimal.
fix.useANumber: Replace it with a number, or move it to a comment column and mark the cell NA.
fix.useADate: Write it as a date, or check the spreadsheet's date format.

vitis.catalogueSheetMissing: The '{sheet}' sheet is missing, so variable columns cannot be resolved to their catalogue label or CropOntology identifier.
vitis.abbreviationColumnMissing: No abbreviation column found in '{sheet}', so stage sheet columns cannot be linked to the catalogue.
vitis.cartoucheSheetMissing: The '{sheet}' sheet is missing. The template states it must be present and fully filled, since every stage sheet repeats it.
vitis.columnsNotInCatalogue: These columns are not listed in '{sheet}': {columns}. Ask the user what they measure and in which unit.
vitis.date1904: This workbook uses the 1904 date system, while the template's instructions require 1900. The dates were read with the workbook's own system, so they are correct as shown, but confirm with the user that the years are the intended ones.
vitis.seasonDisagreement: The '{sheet}' sheet declares the season {declared}, but these sheets declare another one: {others}. The template states the cartouche is used as-is by every sheet, so ask the user which season the data belongs to.
vitis.seasonVersusDates: The declared season is {season} but observation dates fall in {years}. The template warns about the spreadsheet date system: ask the user which year is right before importing anything.
vitis.plotColumnMissing: The '{column}' column is missing from '{sheet}'. The template states the unit plot identifier is mandatory and unique.
vitis.plotIdentifierRepeats: The unit plot identifier repeats in '{sheet}': {values}. The template requires it to be unique, so these rows cannot be told apart.
vitis.cartoucheIncomplete: These cartouche columns are absent from '{sheet}': {columns}. The template requires the cartouche to be complete.

star.experimentSheetMissing: The 'expe' sheet is missing, so the experiment this file describes cannot be identified.
star.plotSheetMissing: No plot sheet was found, so the observations have nothing to attach to.
star.dictionaryMissing: No dictionary sheet was found, so the columns cannot be resolved to their unit, type or ontology identifier.
star.undeclaredVariables: These columns hold observations but the dictionary does not declare them as variables: {columns}. They would be left out of an import. Ask the user whether they are measurements, and add them to the dictionary if so.
star.sheetsNameNoObject: These observation sheets name neither a plot ('{plotColumn}') nor a field ('{fieldColumn}'), so their rows cannot be attached to anything: {sheets}. The 'data_template' sheet shows the expected shape: an object identifier, a date, then the variables.
star.unmatchedPlotIdentifiers: These plot identifiers appear in the observations but match no plot: {values}.
star.objectTypeUndecided: The plot sheet counts plants per plot ('{column}') but never says what a plot is. Ask the user which scientific object type these should be created under before creating any of them.
star.objectTypeUndecidedNoCount: Nothing in the file says what type of scientific object the plots are. Ask the user before creating them.
star.blockModelling: The plots are grouped into blocks ('{column}'). A block can be a scientific object of its own, with the plots as its parts, or a property carried by each plot. Ask the user which: the first is right when something is observed on the block itself.

miappe.mandatoryFieldsEmpty: Section '{section}': the mandatory fields {fields} are empty.
miappe.blankSections: {count} of the {total} MIAPPE sections are still blank templates, with no values under the header.

report.createPersonTitle: Open the person form, name prefilled. The split into given and family name is a guess: correct it.
report.componentsFound: {found} of the {total} components already exist here.

errors.notEnabled: The import assistant is not enabled on this instance.
errors.sessionLost: The conversation has expired. Upload the file again.

mapping.title: Mapping to business entities
mapping.subtitle: Computed from the file template and from the instance, not by the assistant.
mapping.askTemplate: Help me fix the column "{column}" in sheet "{sheet}": {problem}

proposal.title: Proposed creation
proposal.appliedVariables: {count} resource(s) imported — variables and their components.

field.name: Name
field.variableSummary: Variables importable from a shared resource instance
field.reconciliationConfirmed: I confirm how the plot identifiers were matched

from.projectColumn: from the project column of the file
from.trialColumn: from the trial named in the file
from.eventSheets: from the event and treatment sheets
from.sharedResources: from the declared shared resource instances
from.profileReconciliation: from the recomposition the profile applied

block.noDataPoints: No observation could be read from this file.
block.tooManyDataPoints: The file holds too many observations for a single call.
block.notAnalysed: The file has not been checked against the instance yet.
block.experimentMissing: The experiment does not exist yet: create it first.
block.variablesMissing: Some variables are missing from the instance.
block.variablesAmbiguous: Some variables match several entries: one has to be chosen.
block.objectsMissing: Some scientific objects (plots) are missing from the experiment.
block.objectsNotChecked: The scientific objects could not be checked.
block.noImportableVariable: None of the file's variables was found on a shared resource instance.
block.noEvents: No event was read from this file.
block.eventTargetsMissing: None of what these events concerned exists yet: create the field and its plots first.
block.facilitiesMissing: Facilities named by the file are absent from the instance.

refused.title: Insertion refused: nothing was written
refused.explanation: {count} row(s) could not be placed. Insertion is all or nothing: as long as one row cannot find its target or its variable, no value is written, so that an import is never half done without your knowing.

unresolved.object: no scientific object named “{value}” in the experiment

warn.projectMissing: The project named in the file does not exist yet; the experiment can be attached later.
warn.variablesStillMissing: Some variables exist nowhere: after the import, those still have to be created.
warn.someEventTargetsMissing: Some events cannot find what they concerned; those will be skipped.
warn.typeIssues: Some cells do not match the type their variable expects. Check them before inserting.
